target_caveat: Trained and evaluated against GloFAS v4 reanalysis - a MODELLED product, not observed river data. Observed CWC gauge data will replace this when access is granted. Predictions are modelled discharge, never 'river levels'.
decision_statement: trained model beats the best baseline (B3_lag_rule, mean MAE 160.0) on monsoon MAE at h=1 in 4/4 held-out seasons -> SHIP TRAINED MODEL
